name: workspace-switcher
title: Workspace Switcher
description: Picks the active workspace (personal or one of the user's organizations) and starts organizations; the choice is readable outside React for records that belong to the active organization.
docs: `workspace-switcher` installed `WorkspaceProvider`, `useWorkspace` and `WorkspaceSwitcher` under `src/blocks/scope-access/workspace.tsx`. Place `WorkspaceProvider` inside `ScopeAccessProvider`, and the switcher in the sidebar. `New organization` shows only when the app grants the user `create_entity`.
